company.name: Gigacatalyst
company.shortDescription: Gigacatalyst provides an embedded AI customization layer that lets B2B SaaS users build apps, dashboards, and automated workflows.
company.description: Gigacatalyst provides an embedded AI customization layer for B2B SaaS products that enables customers to adapt software to their own workflows. The platform connects to a vendor’s APIs, data models, and design system, and uses natural language input to generate applications, dashboards, and automated workflows. Gigacatalyst is designed for sales teams, customer success teams, and end users who need to build or prototype workflow-specific functionality without adding items to engineering roadmaps. The system runs generated software in a sandboxed environment and inherits the host product’s authentication and role-based access controls. It includes governance tools, spend controls, and an internal app store so organizations can manage distribution and access for the custom tools they create. By operating as a white-label component, Gigacatalyst allows SaaS vendors to present these capabilities under their own brand.
